acceptanceCriteria: A scripted run creates at least three linked worktrees of this repository at one commit, runs the same anchored query in each, and records index bytes on disk, cold and warm query time, and whether the clean base index is built once or per worktree.
The result is recorded in docs/BUILD-LOG.md and in revision-cache-dirty-worktree-v0.md as measured evidence; if the base is rebuilt per worktree a BUG ticket is filed with the numbers.
The run makes no repository mutation beyond creating and removing the temporary worktrees.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from the owner's review of JetBrains Air (jetbrains.com/air, JetBrains blog 2026-09-22): the owner accepted the idea for 1.0. Air is a cloud/IDE orchestration platform; only its contracts transfer. Invariant 7 (AGENTS.md) still holds: no hosted service, UI, daemon or network dependency on the local path. Air isolates concurrent agent tasks in containers and Git worktrees. A worktree per task is now a common host pattern, so the index cost must not multiply per worktree. DIRTY-CACHE-003 (docs/specs/revision-cache-dirty-worktree-v0.md:37) gives a dirty query an unshared freshness view over a remembered clean base, and V1-0155 notes linked worktrees are not refused by the dogfood loop, but no measurement shows N linked worktrees at the same commit reuse one clean index. This ticket measures and records; a fix is a follow-up if the measurement fails.

completion.reason: Completed 2026-09-24 by PR #125 (merge c07f1602a). Criterion 1: script/measure-worktree-index-share.sh created three detached linked worktrees at 01b6804, ran the same anchored query cold, repeat and warm in each, and recorded index bytes (72,803,003 each), wall times and that the clean base was BUILT per worktree (docs/BUILD-LOG.md:7-51). Criterion 2: recorded in docs/BUILD-LOG.md:7 and as measured evidence in docs/specs/revision-cache-dirty-worktree-v0.md:142-151; BUG V1-0212 was filed with the numbers. Criterion 3: worktrees are created only under the scratch dir and removed by an EXIT trap (script lines 20-27, 67-71); before/after worktree list and status matched (BUILD-LOG.md:43-46). Caveats: wall times were taken at load average ~80 and are diagnostic only; the script was not rerun after the exit-3 failure-stop fix. Follow-up: after V1-0212 the script header (lines 5-7) and snapshot_bytes still assume a per-worktree .corvint/index, so a rerun now writes under the Git common dir and reports 0 worktree bytes. Sealed at .corvint/changes/0b5706800e64330888a22e444d1389b661f34b64.cem.json. Evidence digests: sha256 at 6d4873a of the sealed CEM, measure-worktree-index-share.sh, revision-cache-dirty-worktree-v0.md, BUILD-LOG.md. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner focused-verification policy).

title: index: measure that linked worktrees of one repository share the immutable index with only a per-worktree dirty overlay
